Catch margin-negative customers before renewal

A single power user on a flat-rate plan can quietly wipe out the margin of ten normal ones. AI Observly surfaces margin-negative accounts as they happen, so you can fix pricing, add usage limits, or have the conversation before the renewal — not after.
